integrity: A complete local-state proof and standalone deterministic checker are supplied. Tests corroborate but do not certify the infinite theorem; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple rooted trees only, all leaves at equal depth, every internal vertex has at least two children; ordinary domination only. Earlier binary-tree and general tree-DP results are explicitly credited. Bibliographic priority and external validation are not established.
title: Height-three rigidity of minimum dominating sets in irregular branching trees
